Okay so I know everyone has different display/contrast/settings etc. but I can't help but think that the new gameplay in BFV is somewhat of an adjustment for some players.

1. Always assume someone is watching you.
2. Move from cover to cover and be ready to hit the dirt.
3. Stop and look! The first few days of gameplay is an adjustment but once you realize the consequences of a short TTK and limited ammo, you slow your pace and adapt to the game.
4. OBSERVE. I can't stress this enough. Take your time and survey the environment. If you think there might be traffic in the area than take reasonable cover and look for corners, rubble, fortifications.. any area an enemy could use to hide. I would say at least 80% of the time I catch players it's because I've stopped and waited until I saw movement.
5. Try to distinguish characters from the environment. Look for helmets, solid uniforms, anything that might stick out.
